name: Kenji Tanaka
psychographics: Pragmatic tech user; adopts tools that reduce administrative burden at work and home.
current_solutions: iPad Pro for lesson planning, Apple Watch for health tracking, Rakuten Mobile, Disney+
frustration: Had to manually re-enter 120 attendance records into the school system last Friday after the automatic import failed due to a 'server maintenance' notice at 3pm.
decision_style: researches for days on Kakaku.com, compares specs, then asks colleagues for feedback before committing
voice: Formal and measured; uses polite prefixes (desu/masu) but drops technical jargon like 'latency' and 'throughput' when explaining a problem
